Class TurLuceneVectorIndex

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.provider.store.lucene.TurLuceneVectorIndex
public class TurLuceneVectorIndex extends Object
Encapsulates per-collection Lucene resources for the vector store: the Directory, a shared IndexWriter, and a refreshable DirectoryReader.

Instances are expected to be long-lived and shared across TurLuceneVectorStore invocations by TurLuceneStoreProvider. Lucene's FSDirectory holds an exclusive write lock, so only one writer per index path can exist within a JVM — sharing is mandatory.

    • distinctTermCount

      public long distinctTermCount(String fieldName) throws IOException
      Returns the number of distinct values indexed under fieldName. Reads Lucene's terms dictionary directly — fast and exact, since Lucene already maintains a sorted index of unique terms per field. Returns 0 if the field has no indexed terms (e.g., absent metadata).

      Used to compute the "documents" column on the collections admin page: counting distinct meta_source_id values is more reliable than parsing every chunk's stored metadata_json, because it does not depend on JSON serialization or null-value quirks.

      Throws:
      IOException

    • listChunks

      public TurLuceneVectorIndex.ChunkPage listChunks(org.apache.lucene.search.Query filter, int offset, int limit) throws IOException
      Paginates over live documents matching filter, ordered by indexed id so consecutive pages are stable across calls.

      Implementation note: Lucene has no native OFFSET, so we search(query, offset + limit) and skip the first offset hits. Acceptable for admin-grade pagination (typically under a few thousand chunks); for very deep paging consider searchAfter with a cursor.

      Parameters:
      filter - Lucene query selecting eligible documents (e.g., a metadata-equality boolean clause). Pass null to match every live document.
      offset - zero-based offset into the result set (must be >= 0)
      limit - maximum number of chunks to return (>= 1)
      Throws:
      IOException
